🇫🇯 STARLINK LINKS SIX FAR-OFF FIJI SCHOOLS
Deep in the South Pacific—basically the middle of nowhere—six super-remote schools in Fiji got Starlink’s high-speed internet!
Here’s the quick scoop:
• Starlink hooked up kids in nowhere-land with speedy Wi-Fi.
• STEM Surge Science and tech lessons got a major boost, no excuses.
• Virtual Vibes Online learning connects these remote classrooms—boom.
Nailing the global goal to connect all schools by 2030 puts Fiji’s on the map, literally!
Source: fijivillageCom
